section.title: org.osgi.service.typedevent.annotations
section.para: This package contains annotations that can be used to require the Typed Event implementation.
Bundles should not normally need to import this package as the annotations are only used at build-time.

listitem.para: RequireTypedEvent - This annotation can be used to require the Typed Event implementation.

section.title: @RequireTypedEvent
section.para: This annotation can be used to require the Typed Event implementation. It can be used directly, or as a meta-annotation.

This annotation is applied to several of the Typed Event component property type annotations meaning that it does not normally need to be applied to Declarative Services components which use the Typed Event specification.
